whatTheyDo: A flower shop doing everyday arrangements, weddings, sympathy, events, and standing weekly orders, with same-day local delivery.
areaServed: Rockville Centre & nearby Long Island towns

faqs.a: Yes, same-day across Rockville Centre and nearby towns for orders placed by 2pm, and scheduled delivery beyond that.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book a wedding?
faqs.a: The best dates book a season out. Reach out early with the venue and the month and we'll bring ideas to a first call.

faqs.q: Can I just say a budget and let you design?
faqs.a: Absolutely. That's most of what we do. Give us a number and a vibe and we'll run with it.

faqs.q: Do you do sympathy arrangements on short notice?
faqs.a: We do, same-day when we can. Call the shop and we'll handle it gently.

faqs.q: Can I set up weekly flowers?
faqs.a: Yes. A standing weekly order for the house or a business, billed simply, skip any week by text.
